def transform(grid):
    """Draw an 8 line along the leading edge of the colored object,
    perpendicular to the full 2 separator."""
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    cells = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (0, 2, 3, 6)]
    if not cells:
        return g
    # The 2 separator gives the axis of the line to draw.
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    if sep_rows:
        r = min(r for r, c in cells)
        g[r] = [8] * w
    elif sep_cols:
        c = min(c for r, c in cells)
        for r in range(h):
            g[r][c] = 8
    return g

source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for v in row: counts[v] = counts.get(v, 0) + 1
    bg = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    sep_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(v == 2 for v in grid[r])]
    sep_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == 2 for r in range(h))]
    pts = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] != bg and grid[r][c] != 2]
    if not pts: return [row[:] for row in grid]
    color = max(set(grid[r][c] for r,c in pts), key=lambda v: sum(grid[r][c] == v for r,c in pts))
    cells = [(r,c) for r,c in pts if grid[r][c] == color]
    g = [row[:] for row in grid]
    if sep_rows:
        wall = sep_rows[0]
        rmin, rmax = min(r for r,c in cells), max(r for r,c in cells)
        if rmax < wall: dr = wall - 1 - rmax
        else: dr = wall + 1 - rmin
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in cells: g[r+dr][c] = color
        marker = (rmin + dr - 1) if dr >= 0 else (rmax + dr + 1)
        g[marker] = [8] * w
    elif sep_cols:
        wall = sep_cols[0]
        cmin, cmax = min(c for r,c in cells), max(c for r,c in cells)
        if cmax < wall: dc = wall - 1 - cmax
        else: dc = wall + 1 - cmin
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c] = bg
        for r,c in cells: g[r][c+dc] = color
        marker = (cmin + dc - 1) if dc >= 0 else (cmax + dc + 1)
        for r in range(h): g[r][marker] = 8
    return g
'''
